entries.pattern: Safety-type decision makers respond best to case studies with quantified ROI and explicit risk mitigation plans. Proposals without both elements score 30-40% lower in win probability for Safety-type clients.

When Brief mentions '多部门联合评审' (multi-department review), the decision mode is almost always Political. The winning strategy must include stakeholder-specific value propositions, not just one unified narrative.

International 4A agencies competing for local brand pitches typically lead with 'global methodology' and 'award-winning creative'. Their Strategy Gap is usually lack of local market granularity. Local agencies should counter with hyper-local consumer insights.
Opening Hooks that start with a specific data point (e.g., '过去6个月，你们在X渠道的转化率下降了37%') outperform abstract openings by 2-3x in audience engagement. Data-first openings build immediate credibility.

Win rate assessments tend to overestimate when user has strong relationship with client but underestimate execution credibility risks. Always cross-check relationship/price factor against execution credibility to avoid inflated scores.
